digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool search configuration
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before first use, creating friction asymmetry vs. always-loaded tools like Bash.
The ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH environment variable is the only mechanism to control tool deferral; it is global (all-or-nothing), not per-tool or per-server.
No per-tool lever exists to keep only Serena's navigation tools resident while deferring others, making the original acceptance criterion unimplementable.

Disabling tool search (ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false) loads all connected MCP servers' schemas upfront, costing ~25k tokens (Serena alone) to ~64k tokens (full MCP surface), representing a measurable but bounded per-session tax.
A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH disabled, combined with a .gitignore negation, will make Serena tools resident by default without code changes.
